summary: Fade gains scrollContainer and ground="affix". Bound to a scroller, the band's strength follows how much content runs past its edge, easing out over the last band-depth of scroll instead of popping off at the last pixel; it insets itself off a classic scrollbar (right, left in RTL, or bottom) instead of veiling the track; and it renders hidden until measured, server-side too. The strength is written to the band's own style, so scrolling re-renders nothing. ground="affix" paints in the translucent pinned-bar role, so the ramp starts at the bar's own alpha. useScrollEdges exports the measurement under it as scrollDistances(). Card.Body, Combobox and ChatWidget now bind their fades this way.
